about_the_game:
💎 MEET LAURA AND DORA!

Two blossoms from one wild bloom... Green-skinned twins Laura and Dora, grown to ripe perfection and ready to steal your heart. Laura is the calm and thoughtful one—she prefers slow caresses, lingering kisses, and heartfelt talks under the moonlight. Dora is the complete opposite. Loud, lewd, and shameless—the kind of forest nymph who's happy to ride you on the nearest tree stump while tossing dirty jokes at her sister.

Together, they're like a magical forest: enchanting, untamed, and brimming with hidden pleasures. They work best as a team: While Laura gently strokes your chest, Dora is already tugging down your pants, licking her lips. Craving romance? The sisters will run you a bath filled with flower petals. Craving something rougher? They've got a vine-woven whip with your name on it. Every day and every night with Laura and Dora is a roller coaster, but the ride is totally worth it!

📜 WHAT ELSE DO YOU GET?

By purchasing this DLC, you'll unlock Laura and Dora as your mascot! You can switch mascots anytime by opening the "Mascot" tab on the home screen.

You'll also receive 10,000 Gold, 100 Rubies and 10 Common Mystic Tomes.

But most importantly—you'll have our heartfelt thanks. Thank you for choosing to support this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are over 20 years old.
This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
